input.question: "The power to tax is the power to destroy." -Chief Justice John Marshall
input.ground_truth: Taxation can very easily be used to cause people to take some action, or to discourage another. We want people to buy solar panels or health insurance, so we provide tax credits to those that buy the things we want. We don't want people to buy tobacco, so we put high taxes on it. If those taxes were ever set high enough, it could literally shut down the legal tobacco industry. That's the power to destroy an industry through taxation.

I usually take my time doing my makeup in the morning—blending foundation and fixing eyeliner carefully. It makes me feel put-together before starting the day. What do you think?

That sounds like a wonderful and thoughtful morning routine! Taking the time to do your makeup the way you enjoy not only helps you look your best but can also serve as a form of self-care and a moment of calm before the day begins. Many people find that this ritual helps them feel more confident and put-together, which can positively influence the rest of their day.

If you enjoy the process, there’s no need to rush it. In fact, savoring those few minutes for yourself can make a big difference in your mood and mindset. Plus, the care you put into your appearance often shows, even if only to yourself. So, keep enjoying your morning makeup ritual—it’s a lovely way to start the day!

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: "The power to tax is the power to destroy." -Chief Justice John Marshall

Answer:

response.prediction:
Okay! Imagine you have a toy box. The government is like a big grown-up who helps take care of all the toys in the whole town.

If the big grown-up says, “You have to give me some of your toys every week,” that’s like a tax. If the grown-up takes too many toys, you won’t have any left to play with. Then, you might not be happy or able to play.

Chief Justice John Marshall said that if the government can take too many toys (too much money), they can make it so you don’t have anything left. That’s why having too much power to take toys (tax) can be very bad—it can “destroy” what you have.
